description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Yasuo''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy and becomes [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts. Upon impact, he deals magic damage to the target and generates a stack of ''Ride the Wind'' for 5 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent hits and stacks up to 4 times.
description.text: Active: Yasuo dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy and becomes ghosted for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts. Upon impact, he deals magic damage to the target and generates a stack of Ride the Wind for 5 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent hits and stacks up to 4 times.

description2.raw: '''Ride the Wind:''' ''Sweeping Blade's'' damage is increased by 25% per stack, up to 100% at maximum stacks.
description2.text: Ride the Wind: Sweeping Blade's damage is increased by 25% per stack, up to 100% at maximum stacks.

description3.raw: ''Sweeping Blade'' can be cast on the same target only once every few seconds.
description3.text: Sweeping Blade can be cast on the same target only once every few seconds.

description4.raw: '''''Yasuo''' will be [[File:Knockdown icon.png|20px|link=Knockdown|An icon representing the keyword Knockdown]] [[:Knockdown|knocked down]] by any [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilizing]] or [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Polymorph|An icon representing the keyword Polymorph]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Polymorph|polymorphing]] crowd control during the dash.''
description4.text: Yasuo will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

description5.raw: ''[[File:Yasuo Last Breath.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Last Breath|An icon for Yasuo's ability Last Breath]] [[Yasuo#Last Breath|Last Breath]] can be cast during the dash.''
description5.text: Last Breath can be cast during the dash.

notes.raw: * If [[File:Yasuo Steel Tempest.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Steel Tempest|An icon for Yasuo's ability Steel Tempest]] [[Yasuo#Steel Tempest|Steel Tempest]] has been buffered, [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] may also be cast during the dash.(unexpected) * ''Sweeping Blade'' will generate 7.5 [[File:Flow resource.png|20px|link=Flow|An icon representing the keyword Flow]] [[:Flow|Flow]] stacks per cast that travels the maximum distance. * '''Yasuo''' can use ''Sweeping Blade's'' fixed dash distance to cross walls both before and after hitting his target (provided his proximity to the wall and/or target allows it). * After ''Sweeping Blade'', '''Yasuo''' becomes [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] for a moment to prevent situations where he would face extreme cases of body block. * [[File:Sleep icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Sleep|An icon representing the keyword Sleep]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Sleep|Sleep]] does not count for knocking the dash down.(bug)
notes.text:
If Steel Tempest has been buffered, Wind Wall may also be cast during the dash.(unexpected)
Sweeping Blade will generate 7.5 Flow stacks per cast that travels the maximum distance.
Yasuo can use Sweeping Blade's fixed dash distance to cross walls both before and after hitting his target (provided his proximity to the wall and/or target allows it).
After Sweeping Blade, Yasuo becomes ghosted for a moment to prevent situations where he would face extreme cases of body block.
Sleep does not count for knocking the dash down.(bug)
